title: The Hackett Group® Establishes AI World Class Finance Benchmarks
summary: Introducing The Hackett Group's AI World Class Finance benchmarks. Our latest research quantifies how artificial intelligence is reshaping finance performance and reveals a growing gap between organizations that redesign work around AI and those that simply automate existing processes. Organizations pursuing process-led AI transformation are creating performance advantages of up to 75%. The new benchmarks show what's possible across critical finance processes. In order-to-cash, for example, AI World Class organizations can achieve 52%-59% lower process costs, 43% faster dispute resolution, and 85% fewer delinquent days. The message is clear: AI isn't creating a technology gap. It's creating a performance gap.
